  (s : CompositionSeries.{u_2} (Submodule.{u_1, u_2} A V)),
  Eq.{u_2 + 1} (RelSeries.head.{u_2} s) Bot.bot.{u_2} →
    Eq.{u_2 + 1} (RelSeries.last.{u_2} s) Top.top.{u_2} →
      IsGreatest.{0} (Set.range.{0, u_2 + 1} fun l => Nat.cast.{0} (RelSeries.length.{u_2} l))
        (Nat.cast.{0} (RelSeries.length.{u_2} s))
